source.sha256_method: sha256 over 2 tables' full unfiltered COPY (ORDER BY <pk-or-natural-key>) WITH (FORMAT CSV) output, each preceded by a 'TABLE:<schema>.<table>' header line, concatenated in fixed alphabetical order: nq_basicdata.relatedcode (ORDER BY code), nq_basicdata.stock (ORDER BY code)
source.reuse_note: nq_basicdata.stock content overlaps byte-for-byte with the batch already pinned by security_master/security_profile/financial_facts/quote_snapshot/corporate_actions/sdi_disclosure/directorate/ownership, but this promotion's own correctness argument depends on the exact 2-table set it reads together (entity scope + the 1 related-warrants-specific table itself), so it mints its own self-contained batch rather than cross-referencing another promotion's pin -- same reasoning every prior promotion used for its own batch.

promotion.new_migration_reason: Like sdi_disclosure, directorate, and ownership (the three prior Netquity slices whose domain had no pre-existing value), no 'related_warrants'/'warrants'/'derivatives' domain value existed anywhere in aiphabee_core.serving_dataset_domain_check. deploy/database/migrations/20260716140000_related_warrants_domain.sql extends the CHECK constraint (drop + re-add, the same mechanism the ipo_pipeline/hkex_news/sdi_disclosure/directorate/ownership domain migrations each used) with no table creation, access grant, or data load.
promotion.serving_dataset_domain_note: dataset and domain use the identical value 'related_warrants' (both are new values minted together by this promotion, so no pre-existing naming convention constrained a match, the same as sdi_disclosure/directorate/ownership). Named 'related_warrants' rather than bare 'warrants' because the promoted content is exactly and only nq_basicdata.relatedcode's underlying-to-warrant linkage (a relational fact), not warrant master data (terms/quotes) -- see excluded_from_this_cut.warrant_terms_no_fact_table for why no such master-data table exists in this mirror.
promotion.new_index_required_reason: entity_id lookup uses the leading prefix of the existing serving_record unique index (serving_snapshot_id, entity_type, entity_id, ...)

rights_basis.distinct_from_quote_snapshot: quote_snapshot deliberately uses its own 'netquity-market-data-staging.v1' policy version because market-data Web distribution rights were confirmed separately; related_warrants has no comparable separate rights determination and is covered by the original Netquity collaboration rights approval already used by security_master/security_profile/financial_facts/corporate_actions/sdi_disclosure/directorate/ownership, so this promotion reuses 'netquity-collaboration-staging.v1' rather than minting a new policy version. related_warrants also carries no priced/quoted field (see excluded_from_this_cut.warrant_quote_or_pricing), unlike quote_snapshot, reinforcing that it is reference/structural data, not market data.
rights_basis.account_context_independence: resolveRelatedWarrants filters aiphabee_governance.data_entitlement/aiphabee_core.serving_dataset by context.rights_policy_version (the account's platform.workspace_product_access.policy_version), the same as resolveProfile/resolveFinancialFacts/resolveCorporateActions/resolveSdiDisclosure/resolveDirectorate/resolveOwnership -- no hardcoded policy-version constant is introduced.
rights_basis.personal_data_basis: nq_basicdata.relatedcode carries no personal-data column at all: it is a code-to-code association table (one underlying code mapped to comma-separated warrant codes across 5 category columns) with no name, address, or identity field of any kind. The promoted warrants[].name fields are sourced from nq_basicdata.stock, the same company/instrument-identity table already promoted via security_master/security_profile/ownership -- every one of the 9639 promoted warrant links resolves to a structured-product instrument issued by one of 28 institutional entities in nq_codetable.warrantissuer (verified: all bank/broker corporate names, e.g. 'J.P. Morgan Structured Products B.V.', never an individual), so no individual person is named anywhere in this dataset.
rights_basis.no_field_excluded_for_pii: verified: nq_basicdata.relatedcode's 12 columns are code (integer PK), the 5 promoted warrant-category comma-lists, 4 further non-warrant code-list/pointer columns (equity/mcountercodelist/parallelcode/rightscode, excluded for being out of the warrants scope, not for PII), and equity_reason (verified 0/2836 populated in the current mirror). None carry personal data; no field was excluded on personal-data grounds this cut.

payload_shape_choice.task_examples: warrants[] (single uniform array; category as a per-entry attribute)
payload_shape_choice.chosen_shape: warrants[] (single uniform array; category as a per-entry attribute, not a separate top-level array per category)
payload_shape_choice.rationale: nq_basicdata.relatedcode exposes 5 warrant-category columns (comp_warrant/dp_warrant/dc_warrant/cc_warrant/ce_warrant), but every code in every one of those 5 columns resolves to the identical shape once joined against nq_basicdata.stock: an instrumentId and a tri-lingual name. Unlike corporate_actions' 4 action types (dividend/split/buyback/consolidation), which each carry a genuinely different sub-schema (ex-date+rate vs ratio vs value vs terms) and were promoted as 4 separate typed arrays, related-warrants' 5 categories differ only in a single discriminator tag with no structural difference in the rest of the entry -- the same 'uniform array, type is just an attribute' shape ownership chose for holders[] (holderType/groupType/sourceType as attributes, not a split array per type). Emitting 5 near-identical arrays (compWarrants[]/dpWarrants[]/dcWarrants[]/ccWarrants[]/ceWarrants[]) would duplicate the same entry shape 5 times in the field contract for zero added information; a single warrants[] array with a raw category attribute keeps one source of truth per instrument while still letting a caller group or filter client-side by category, matching this cut's explicit template (directorate/ownership), not the differently-shaped corporate_actions/sdi_disclosure precedent.

excluded_from_this_cut.etfdata2_relatedcode_table: nq_etfdata2.relatedcode (412 rows) carries the identical 5 warrant-category column shape as nq_basicdata.relatedcode, but is scoped to ETF underlyings (its own product universe, joined against nq_etfdata2.etf, not nq_basicdata.stock). This cut's entity_id_pattern (hkex_security_<code>, aligned with security_resolution's equity/general-instrument universe) does not cover the ETF-specific universe nq_etfdata2.relatedcode indexes into. Out of scope for this cut, which reads only the 2,836-row nq_basicdata.relatedcode table; not promoted or merged in.
excluded_from_this_cut.warrant_terms_no_fact_table: nq_codetable.warrantissuer (28 rows: institutional issuer names, e.g. 'J.P. Morgan Structured Products B.V.'), nq_codetable.warranttype2 (15 rows: structure-type labels, e.g. 'N類'/CBBC Type N, 'IL'/Inline), and nq_codetable.underlyingcode (35 rows: index/commodity/FX/single-stock underlying labels) all exist as decode/reference tables in the current mirror, but were verified -- via a full information_schema.columns search across every schema in the mirror for issuer/strike/expir/exercis/underlying/calllevel/conversion/maturit/gearing-named columns -- to have zero fact table anywhere in this mirror carrying a foreign-key-shaped column into any of the 3. nq_marketdata.stock (checked specifically per this cut's own brief for warrant-terms columns such as strike price or expiry date) was verified to carry only generic cross-instrument valuation/technical fields (lastprice, ma10/20/50/90/250, rsi10/14, lastpe, marketcap, etc.), not warrant-specific terms. No strike/exercise price, expiry/maturity date, issuer code, warrant-type code, or underlying-code fact column exists anywhere in the current mirror for warrant instruments. Therefore no issuer/type/underlying decode join, and no strike/expiry term, is attachable to any promoted field this cut -- warrants[].category is promoted as its raw relatedcode column key instead of a decoded label (same 'no fact table -> promote raw, do not invent' discipline sdi_disclosure applied to formType/eventCode, directorate to capacity, and ownership to holderType/groupType/sourceType). Note (non-authoritative, not used as a promotion rule): the warrant instruments' own free-text engname values follow an informal 'EP'/'EC' substring convention that is directionally consistent with dp_warrant=put and dc_warrant=call (e.g. code 14662's engname 'CI-CK Hutchison@EP2612A' under CK Hutchison's dp_warrant list; code 13005's engname 'SG-Tencent@EC2703A' under Tencent's dc_warrant list) -- this is observed only as corroborating context that the raw category tags correspond to a real, consistent vendor grouping, and is deliberately not parsed or promoted as a decoded field, since regex-deriving semantics from a free-text display name is exactly the kind of shadow-parsing this cut's decode discipline prohibits.
excluded_from_this_cut.relatedcode_non_warrant_columns: nq_basicdata.relatedcode.equity (630/2836 populated), mcountercodelist (48/2836), parallelcode (39/2836), and rightscode (6/2836) describe different relation types -- related equity share classes, multi-currency-counter siblings, parallel listings, and rights issues, respectively -- not warrants. equity_reason is verified 0/2836 populated in the current mirror. All 5 are out of scope for this cut's explicit warrants-only scope and are not read into any promoted field.
excluded_from_this_cut.il_warrant_column: nq_basicdata.relatedcode.il_warrant (Inline warrant linkage) is verified 0/2836 populated -- completely unpopulated in the current mirrored snapshot, unlike the other 4 categories which each have at least 6 populated rows. Excluded from the promoted category vocabulary; the promotion SQL's preflight asserts this stays exactly 0 so any future drift (a mirror refresh that starts populating it) is caught rather than silently absorbed or silently promoted as a 6th category with no verified example.
excluded_from_this_cut.warrant_own_trading_status: nq_basicdata.stock.tradingstatus is populated for every one of the 9639 related warrants' own instrument rows (verified: 9476 'N'/normal, 163 'S'/suspended among the 9639 links -- suspension near/at expiry is expected, ordinary warrant-market behavior, not a data anomaly). Deferred rather than promoted: the warrant's own listing/trading status belongs to that instrument's own security_profile domain (instrumentId-keyed, already promoted), not to this underlying-to-warrant relational-link payload -- embedding a second copy here would risk it silently going stale relative to the authoritative per-instrument record.
excluded_from_this_cut.warrant_quote_or_pricing: No last price, daily change percent, implied premium, or effective gearing is computed or promoted this cut. The design baseline (docs/AiphaBee Design System/apps/netquity-workbench/quote.jsx's NqWarrantsView) shows these as demo-only derived figures; this promotion is relational-link data only (which warrant codes are associated with which underlying), not warrant market data. A warrant's own quote, once its instrumentId is known from this payload, is addressable via the existing instrument-keyed quote_snapshot domain if and when that promotion's own coverage extends to warrant-class instruments -- not re-derived or estimated here.
excluded_from_this_cut.personal_data_columns: verified: neither nq_basicdata.relatedcode nor the joined nq_basicdata.stock name columns carry any address, identity-document number, date-of-birth, or contact-detail column, and every promoted name is a corporate/structured-product instrument name, never an individual's (see rights_basis.personal_data_basis). No field was excluded on personal-data grounds this cut.

entity_scope_choice.rationale: Like the five prior full-universe promotions, there is no comparable 'known but structurally out of scope' bucket for related warrants -- any listed instrument could in principle have associated derivative warrants or CBBCs. Building the full 18,036-instrument universe with an explicit coverage.status=unavailable marker (quote_snapshot/corporate_actions/sdi_disclosure/directorate/ownership's idiom) keeps the distinction between 'no related-warrant data currently promoted' and true absence, and lets the new RelatedWarrantsPanel render a calm EmptyPanel state instead of an error card. Having zero related warrants is the overwhelming norm (only 309/18,036 = 1.7% of instruments carry any, verified), consistent with real-world HKEX warrant issuance concentrating on a small set of liquid large-cap underlyings -- the single most-covered underlying in this mirror, hkex_security_00700 (Tencent), alone accounts for 715 of the 9,639 promoted links.

web.synthetic_counterpart: none -- like sdi_disclosure, directorate, and ownership, related_warrants never had a synthetic scaffold anywhere in packages/workbench: it is a genuinely new tab, not a synthetic->live cutover of an existing one. The tab's status dot therefore has no StockWorkbenchSection key to read and renders neutral rather than a fabricated found/not-found state.
web.design_baseline: docs/AiphaBee Design System/apps/netquity-workbench/quote.jsx's NqWarrantsView -- the code/name/type table columns are rendered per this cut's real, promoted fields only (instrumentId/category/name); the design baseline's price/1-day-change/expiry/strike/call-level/premium/gearing columns are not built this cut, since no such vendor fact table exists in the mirrored schema this cut reads (see excluded_from_this_cut.warrant_terms_no_fact_table and .warrant_quote_or_pricing); list rendering of instrumentId + name + raw category suffices per this cut's scope.
